verdict.label: separate
verdict.why: Both functions branch on StreamCommit kind and phase, but they compute different things. entryBody builds the content of a scrollback entry (text, markdown or reasoning bodies, mono handling, interrupted messages). entryLook only picks a foreground color and attributes from the theme. There is no shared executable operation, only a similar dispatch shape over the same input type. The overlapping conditions (kind === 'user', phase === 'final') are trivial checks with different outcomes for different purposes, so they do not amount to a reusable policy. Extracting a helper would only be generic branching syntax.
